book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel tal ol wangwo ha bol engwi

content: Arihobi Pita Yon kina hane sungwo ha
Ena Pita Yon yasuri ha i di te mongure, ha maing oo singaba ire, ha maing oo bir er kwi nu mole kene ongwo yal ta ire, Sadyusi ire dire, u pa dungwi.
Dungure yasuri, Yisas golere hon airungwo mere ari tau yu onamua dire boling kul te momia, arihobi u hanere nigi de pungwi.
Pirere yasuri han sire, tanangwo ha hol ol terala dire, hamen girimia, halabusi oo ala i olungure, pai mongwi.
Pai momba, Pita Yon yasuri ha nir si tongwo i, ari miki weni wine olere, Yisas pir tongwi. Pir tongwo hobi iwe, yagir namba imu dire paib tausen mongwi.
Yasuri aule ire pire kaunsel mongwo bani ha hol ol tongwo ha
Ena hamen tangure, ha maing oo singaba ire, ha maing yal bir ire, Lo ha nir si tongwo tisa ire dire, Yerusalem malgi i ku bole mongwi.
Mongure Yuda ha maing oo kene ongwo yal bir Anas ire, Kaiapas ire, Yon ire, Aleksanda ire, singaba tau ire dire, para u ku bole mongwi.
Molere aposel suri aule ire, sina ure, yu sirin bol pungwi, “Ni talmere ole yulang bole honagi one? Ara yulang ni tongure, haang dal yuwo erere, tal i one?”
Ditongwo gin iwe, God nin Kwiang ure Pita yong wu bilere, a kulang pai tongure, nimni mole yalhobi yu ditongwi, “Yuda ari yal bir ye,
Yalhobo, yal ta kebering kebir engwo na yasuri aki di tobilga u wai ongwo i hanere dino?

Dinanga ni Isrel ari hobi kina para piro. Nasaret hong yal Yisas Kraist ni yalhobi er pera bani si gonga gongure, God nin uling yungure airimia. Airungwo yal iwe, yulang na tongure, haang dal yuwo ere awai ol tobilga kebir engwo yali u wai ongwo hania.
Yisas haang pungwo mere ha maing buku yu di emiraya, Oo kengwo yalhobi torari ta ire mebin dama dire aidolamba, olangwo torari i God nin ire bring torari sinangure nima pire dinamua. Sam 118:22

Dinangwo meri iwe, Yisas ere yu nima pire momua. Molere yal i nin muru arihobi aki di tongure, sigare kule u wai ongure, te emgi tau u wai namua. Yal ta monangure, God yulang tenangwo awai onangure sigare kulkinamia. Yal i tani momua.”

Ena arihobi Yon Pita kina grang bani han momba, ha nimni mole dimia, ari hobi hanere, “ayo, yasuri sikul ta dikimiraya, ha i tal ole dime?” di hanere nomani si gogo dangwi. Damba, homa iwo yasuri Yisas kina wangwo hamingirawe di pungwi.
Pirere kura ha di tenamba, kebir engwo awai ol tongwo yal i ure Yon Pita kina si daule aire mongwo hangwi. Hanere yalhobi ha ta ditenamba, grang oun dongure han ole mongwi.
Molere ere pi maini monana po ditere, yalhobi nin ha diriyala olungwi.
Olere, yu dungwi, “Nan gina yasuri tal ol tenamne? Tal guma hon dongwo ongwo i Yerusalem ari hobi para han po sire momia, nan aulu bai haunaminga paikimua.
Paikimba, guung haang i ari ganba bina holo holi pirikinama dire, Yisas haang dale honagi olkio dire mana ditenaminua,” dungwi.
Dire, “hon ala wo” ditongure ungure, “Yisas haang dal yuwo ere ha i ari hon nir si tekio,” dire mana giring ditongwi.
Ditomba, Pita Yon kina ha mong yu ditongwi, “Na yasuri God grang wine obilga i pisolere, ni gran wine olabilga wai panam mo? Nomani si pir kun olio.
Na yasu Yisas tal ongwo hanere, grang pirere dibilga i, pir uning si ole ta molkirabilua.”

Dungure u ku bongwo hobi yasuri kul pinama dire, han tere erepo ditongwi. Ditongure yasuri tal ongwo i ari hobi hanere, God haang dale maa e tomia, ari u ku bongwo hobi yasuri sinangwo paikungure, han olimia, ere ongwi.
Ena kebir engwo awai ol tongwo yal iwe, yagaling ta molkimia, ari yal me erin yal su kebering aling poti mongwi.
Yasuri ere ongure gamahobi kina yong tani ere God maa e tongwo ha
Ena Pita Yon kina ere gamahobo tau mongwo pirere, singaba hobi ha ditongwo meri boling kul tongwi.
Tomia pirere, yalhobi kina yong tani ere mole, God ha yu ditongwi, “Yulang hong yal ye, ni hamen ganba ya, nir sol wara ya, talhan ganba bani pangwo hobi ni ol enua.
Homa ni Kwian ure kwiana moya ni honagi ol ni tongwo yal Debit yong wu bimia. Bungure Debit grang bani yu dinia, ‘Ari wiyol tau talongure yong ki eme? Te ari tau talongure nomani miki miki si pime?
Te ganba ganba singaba king para weni u ku bolere, God singaba Kraist kina a ime ol terala dire, yulung bomua.’ Sam 2:1,2

Dire Debit ha yu dungwiwe, omaga nima omua. Singaba king Herot ire, Pontias Pailat ire, ari wiyol tau ire, Isrel ari ire dire, ni wani Yisas Kraist tal dime dire ongwo yal i a ime olala dire yulang bomua.
Bolere nin pungwo mere pire tal yu ol wamiba, ongwiwe, ni homa yulan bole nomani pire tal yu olala dire onga meri omua.
Nabe, yalhobi tal gogo ol na terala dire ongwo hania, ni aki di na tengere, nimni mole, ni ol wai ol tenga ha maing di tibi ol tenamna.
Tenamingere ari nibil ongwo i ni nin yulan to. Tere ni wani Yisas han dal yuwo ere tal nimni mongwo miki weni onama di pinga meri aki di na to.”
Di te pisolungure, oo i ememe ongwo tani hol wangure, God nin Kwiang ure ari hobi yong wu bungure, sipapa sire, nimni molere, ari moma ama di pirikire ha maing di tongwi.
Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yong tani engwo ha
Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yong miling tani ere mongwi. Molere, “I na talna dimua,” dikire, gol male a nongwo dimia hangwo hangwo i holo holo ongwi.
Ongure aposel hobi yulang ki bolere, Yisas golere hon airungwo ha i boling kul tongwi. Tomia God hanere, pirari pare aki di tongure u tani pire pana gangwi.
Gamia yalhobi mongwo sina i yal ta gal kul nir homena ta wa dukima. Yalhobi ganba ya, oo ke pangwo hobi yal tau tere moni bol ingwi.
Ingwo moni iwe, ire, aposel hobi tongwi. Tongure aposel hobi ire talhan a nekungwo hobi aki di tere tongwi.
Ena yu ongwiwe, yol Yuda Libai yal ta Saipras malgi kul engwo yal, Yosep aposel hobo haang hon Banabas engwi. Engwo haang iwe, memini yu pamia di gon gan ongwo yal momia.
Molere ganba ya nongwo ta yal ta tere moni bol ingwi. Bol ingwo moni iwe, i ure aposel hobi tongwi.
